title: My Savior My God
lyrics: Verse 1:
[D]I am not skilled to understand
What God has willed, what God has pl[Bm7]anned.
I only know at His right [A]hand
Stands one who is my Sa[D2]vior.
Verse 2:
I take Him at His word and deed.
Christ died to save me this I read.
And in my heart I find a need
Of Him to be my Savior.
Pre-Chorus 1:
That He would leave His place on h[G2]igh
And come for sinful man to [D2]die,
You count it strange, so once did[Asus] I,
Before I knew my Sa[D2]vior.
Chorus 1:
My Savior [Bm7]loves. My Savior [G2]lives.
My Savior's al[D2]ways there for [A]me.
My God He [Bm7]was. My God He [G2]is.
My God is [D]always gonna b[A]e. (2X)
Verse 3:
Yes, living, dying let me bring
My strength, my solace
from this spring
That He who lives to be my King
Once died to be my Savior.
